jobs_results.title: Revenue Insights Analyst, Customer Success

job_highlights.title: Qualifications
items: 5–7+ years of experience in analytics, revenue operations, or a data-heavy business intelligence role—ideally at a B2B SaaS company
Strong SQL skills and experience building reports and dashboards in Tableau, Looker, or equivalent BI tools
Solid understanding of SaaS revenue metrics: pipeline, ARR, conversion rates, churn, NRR, CAC, LTV
Experience working with Salesforce and/or HubSpot data—you know where the data lives and how to pull it reliably
Exceptional data storytelling skills—you can turn a complex analysis into a clear narrative that non-technical stakeholders can act on
Detail-oriented with strong data validation instincts—you don't ship an analysis until you've pressure-tested it
Proactive and intellectually curious—you bring questions and hypotheses, not just answers
Stakeholder Satisfaction – Feedback from GTM leaders on analytical support quality and responsiveness

job_highlights.title: Responsibilities
items: You'll be a proactive analytical partner to GTM teams, surfacing the trends and signals that drive better decisions—and helping leaders ask better questions of their data
You'll work closely with the broader RevOps and Revenue Intelligence teams, and your work will have a direct line to how we allocate resources, prioritize accounts, and forecast revenue
If you love digging into messy data, building clean reports, and telling the story behind the numbers—this role is for you

You'll provide the analytical support that enables data-driven optimization across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success—and help build the self-serve reporting infrastructure that scales with the business

Dashboards & Reporting – Build and maintain dashboards and reports across the GTM funnel—from top-of-funnel acquisition through pipeline, conversion, and retention—using tools like Tableau, Looker, or Salesforce reports
Funnel Analysis – Analyze funnel performance and trends to identify conversion bottlenecks, drop-off points, and opportunities for improvement across Marketing, Sales, and CS
Forecasting Support – Partner with RevOps leadership to support forecasting and planning processes with clean, reliable data analysis and scenario modeling

Growth & Efficiency Insights – Proactively identify opportunities to improve revenue efficiency—surfacing insights about pipeline quality, campaign performance, rep productivity, and customer health that GTM leaders can act on
Executive Reporting – Deliver clear, concise insights to leadership in the formats they need—whether that's a weekly pipeline report, a QBR package, or an ad hoc analysis on a key business question
Data Quality Partnership – Partner with the Revenue Intelligence team to identify data quality issues, validate analysis inputs, and ensure the integrity of the insights you deliver
Time to Insight – Average time from business question to data-backed answer
Dashboard Adoption Rate – Active usage of self-serve dashboards and reports across GTM teams
Accuracy of Analysis – Error rate in delivered analyses and reports
Impact of Recommendations – GTM decisions influenced by analysis, tracked through qualitative and quantitative feedback

jobs_results.description:
About OpenLoopOpenLoop was co-founded by CEO, Dr. Jon Lensing, and COO, Christian Williams, with the vision to bring care anywhere. Our telehealth support solutions are thoughtfully designed to streamline and simplify go-to-market care delivery for companies offering meaningful virtual support to patients across an expansive array of specialties, in all 50 states.

Data is only as valuable as the decisions it drives. At OpenLoop, we're looking for a GTM Insights Analyst who can turn complex revenue data into clear, actionable insights—building the dashboards, analyses, and reports that help Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams understand what's working, what isn't, and what to do next.

This isn't a passive reporting role. You'll be a proactive analytical partner to GTM teams, surfacing the trends and signals that drive better decisions—and helping leaders ask better questions of their data. You'll work closely with the broader RevOps and Revenue Intelligence teams, and your work will have a direct line to how we allocate resources, prioritize accounts, and forecast revenue.

If you love digging into messy data, building clean reports, and telling the story behind the numbers—this role is for you.

Why This Role Exists

Limited analytical bandwidth is slowing decision-making and reducing our ability to identify performance gaps across the funnel. GTM leaders need faster, more reliable access to insights—and a partner who can help them understand what the data is actually saying.

This role fills that gap. You'll provide the analytical support that enables data-driven optimization across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success—and help build the self-serve reporting infrastructure that scales with the business.

What You'll Own

Dashboards & Reporting – Build and maintain dashboards and reports across the GTM funnel—from top-of-funnel acquisition through pipeline, conversion, and retention—using tools like Tableau, Looker, or Salesforce reports.

Funnel Analysis – Analyze funnel performance and trends to identify conversion bottlenecks, drop-off points, and opportunities for improvement across Marketing, Sales, and CS.

Forecasting Support – Partner with RevOps leadership to support forecasting and planning processes with clean, reliable data analysis and scenario modeling.

Growth & Efficiency Insights – Proactively identify opportunities to improve revenue efficiency—surfacing insights about pipeline quality, campaign performance, rep productivity, and customer health that GTM leaders can act on.

Executive Reporting – Deliver clear, concise insights to leadership in the formats they need—whether that's a weekly pipeline report, a QBR package, or an ad hoc analysis on a key business question.

Data Quality Partnership – Partner with the Revenue Intelligence team to identify data quality issues, validate analysis inputs, and ensure the integrity of the insights you deliver.

What We're Looking For

5–7+ years of experience in analytics, revenue operations, or a data-heavy business intelligence role—ideally at a B2B SaaS company

Strong SQL skills and experience building reports and dashboards in Tableau, Looker, or equivalent BI tools

Solid understanding of SaaS revenue metrics: pipeline, ARR, conversion rates, churn, NRR, CAC, LTV

Experience working with Salesforce and/or HubSpot data—you know where the data lives and how to pull it reliably

Exceptional data storytelling skills—you can turn a complex analysis into a clear narrative that non-technical stakeholders can act on

Detail-oriented with strong data validation instincts—you don't ship an analysis until you've pressure-tested it

Proactive and intellectually curious—you bring questions and hypotheses, not just answers

How We'll Measure Success

Time to Insight – Average time from business question to data-backed answer

Dashboard Adoption Rate – Active usage of self-serve dashboards and reports across GTM teams

Accuracy of Analysis – Error rate in delivered analyses and reports

Impact of Recommendations – GTM decisions influenced by analysis, tracked through qualitative and quantitative feedback

Stakeholder Satisfaction – Feedback from GTM leaders on analytical support quality and responsiveness

Our CompanyWe have a relatively flat organizational structure here at OpenLoop. Everyone is encouraged to bring ideas to the table and make things happen. This fits in well with our core values of Autonomy, Competence and Belonging, as we want everyone to feel empowered and supported to do their best work.

Sound like a good fit? We’d love to meet you.

job_highlights.title: Responsibilities
items: You’ll be embedded with our sales organization and serve as a bridge between shopper insights and sales, helping partners understand what shoppers are doing, why behaviors are changing, and where new opportunities exist
You’ll support the Big G Cereal and Dry Baking businesses while working across brands, categories, and business questions

Your work will combine syndicated data, panel data, survey research, and other quantitative and qualitative inputs to create clear insights stories that keep the shopper, consumer, customer, and business at the center of decisions
What You’ll Do Respond to day-to-day questions from the sales team, turning business needs into focused analyses and actionable insights
Analyze shopper, consumer, category, product, and purchase-basket behavior using syndicated, panel, point-of-sale, survey, and other data sources
Use tools and platforms such as Scintilla/Luminate, Numerator, Nielsen, and comparable data or survey systems
Investigate how shopping behavior differs across channels or occasions
Build concise, compelling presentations and quick-turn analyses for sales partners, merchants, General Mills stakeholders, line reviews, innovation reviews, and other customer engagements
Support innovation and concept learning by programming or analyzing surveys, including purchase intent, substitution, complementarity, and shopper response questions
Partner with Insights counterparts to develop and share insights across products, brands, categories, and strategies
Participate in broader Shopper Insights projects that explore topics such as value perceptions, economic and macro trends, nutrition-related shifts, and changing household shopping behavior
Translate complex data into a clear “so what,” prioritizing the information most useful for the audience and decision at hand
Build strong relationships in a matrixed organization and participate actively in team meetings, knowledge sharing, and best-practice development
Maintain a growth mindset by learning new tools, methods, and ways of working and identifying opportunities to create broader impact
Experience analyzing panel data, purchase baskets, omnichannel behavior, digital shopping, or in-store behavior
Relocation assistance will be provided if you are not local to the area

jobs_results.description: COMPANY OVERVIEW We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next. As a Shopper Insights Analyst, you’ll help drive growth with Walmart, one of General Mills’ most important retail customers. You’ll be embedded with our sales organization and serve as a bridge between shopper insights and sales, helping partners understand what shoppers are doing, why behaviors are changing, and where new opportunities exist. You’ll support the Big G Cereal and Dry Baking businesses while working across brands, categories, and business questions. Your work will combine syndicated data, panel data, survey research, and other quantitative and qualitative inputs to create clear insights stories that keep the shopper, consumer, customer, and business at the center of decisions. Analyze shopper, consumer, category, product, and purchase-basket behavior using syndicated, panel, point-of-sale, survey, and other data sources. Use tools and platforms such as Scintilla/Luminate, Numerator, Nielsen, and comparable data or survey systems. Investigate how shopping behavior differs across channels or occasions. Build concise, compelling presentations and quick-turn analyses for sales partners, merchants, General Mills stakeholders, line reviews, innovation reviews, and other customer engagements. Support innovation and concept learning by programming or analyzing surveys, including purchase intent, substitution, complementarity, and shopper response questions. Build strong relationships in a matrixed organization and participate actively in team meetings, knowledge sharing, and best-practice development. Maintain a growth mindset by learning new tools, methods, and ways of working and identifying opportunities to create broader impact. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Market Research, Data Analytics, Psychology, Business, or a related field. 1+ year of experience in consumer or shopper insights, market research, category management, data analytics, sales analytics, or a related field. Demonstrated interest in understanding the reasons behind shopper and consumer behavior. Ability to work with data, manipulate and extract information into Excel or comparable analytical tools, and learn new platforms quickly. Ability to synthesize multiple data sources and inputs into a simple, compelling story. Strong communication and storytelling skills, including the ability to tailor information to a sales, marketing, merchant, or executive audience. Comfort working in a fast-paced, agile, and collaborative environment. Strong command of syndicated data and shopper or consumer research methods. Experience analyzing panel data, purchase baskets, omnichannel behavior, digital shopping, or in-store behavior. Experience developing or programming surveys and interpreting quantitative or qualitative research. Experience presenting insights to senior leaders, customers, or cross-functional partners. Curiosity about market research, shopper motivations, and the broader forces shaping household purchasing behavior. Additional Considerations This role is located at the Bentonville, AR Walmart Business Center. Relocation assistance will be provided if you are not local to the area.
